title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Home-Settling Period for the Closing Contact
content:
The **home-settling period** taken into account for the closing contact of a health-care absence on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is measured in whole calendar months from the absence start date to the return date stated on the return notice (the accepted return-home notice about the primary borrower received most recently):

| Absence start date | Home-settling period |
|---|---|
| 6 or more whole calendar months before the return date | 21 calendar days |
| 3 or more but fewer than 6 whole calendar months before it | 10 calendar days |
| fewer than 3 whole calendar months before it | zero days |
| no return notice on file | zero days |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.
